company.name: Kleen
company.shortDescription: Clean is a technical solutions company for the laundry sector.
company.description:
Kleen provides distinctive technical solutions, including Kleen Bag, which provides a unique laundry experience that achieves the highest levels of comfort and quality for customers in terms of receiving and delivering the laundry without the need for direct communication between the customer and the service provider.

Kleen is also working on developing an integrated system of technology solutions to enable service providers to raise the level of quality, control operations, reduce service costs, and improve customer experience. To ensure the quality of the services provided, the company contracts with service providers within the framework of the Tech Franchise, a business model that is being applied for the first time in the laundry sector in the Kingdom.

productsAndServices.description: A laundry service where customers leave a Kleen bag at their door for contactless pickup, washing, and delivery of clothes without direct interaction with delivery personnel.
